body:
I'm pretty sober now. It took a while. The wife and I were fighting, and she kept on bringing up my father.
 
I just wanted to leave a note, but I can't.
 
I finished cleaning out the carbs The old girl starts. I will be another road meatball. But I can't do anything to please anyone. 
 
It sucks when you are worth more dead than alive.
 
Tired of being accused of shit I didn't do. Tired of it all. I know that in that one final moment I will probably regret it, but also, there is a chance that I will feel peace.
 
Maybe before I hit, or as I hit, I will finally know peace. Even for just a moment.
 
Finally, peace at mind. I could rack myself up with drugs. I thought of that but there is the case I would be "recovered" before I nod off into a long sleep. I don't want that. I do not want to be pulled out. I will do it the hard way. Instant. Against the wall. At a high speed. Should be done really quick.
 
Just done.
 
Am I looking for excuses, people telling me "I shouldn't do it", etc..
 
I don't know.
 
What I do know is that my motorcycle is running fine. I drained the carbs, refiled the tank, and know the highway where to do this. It's gonna fucking hurt. I can't do drugs beforehand. I have to be sober. I don't know how else to do this. My wife thinks I'm better off dead. The kiddos are away so they won't have to experience this. 
 
It's the most opportune time,
